formatted_text: Passing may **never** be done by driving on the **shoulder or the verge** of a public road.

**Don't pass** other traffic when approaching the **summit of a rise**, a **curve**, or anywhere visibility is **too restricted** to see oncoming traffic, **unless** you can do so **without encroaching right**, or the road is restricted to **one direction**.
When another vehicle wants to pass you, **keep left** and **don't accelerate** until it has passed.
A driver wanting to overtake a vehicle ahead (not in the left lane) may signal their intention by **flashing their headlights**.
On a freeway, **keep left** and **overtake on the right**.
At a junction where vehicles must move around a **traffic island**, **give way to all traffic approaching from your right**, unless a traffic officer or road sign directs you otherwise.

**Don't park**:
(i) where a **traffic officer directs otherwise**,
(ii) in contravention of a **sign**,
(iii) where stopping **isn't permitted**,
(iv) where the vehicle would **obscure a road sign**,
(v) on the **sidewalk**, or
(vi) **blocking** a private or public vehicular entrance.
**Don't park** within **1.5 metres** of a **fire hydrant**.

**Outside** an urban area, **don't park** on the roadway (**excluding the shoulder**), or with any part of the vehicle within **1 metre** of the roadway edge, **except for reasons beyond your control**.

**Within** an urban area, **don't park**:
(i) within **9 metres** of the approach side of a pedestrian crossing,
(ii) within **5 metres** of an intersection,
(iii) over a **traffic signal's mechanism**,
(iv) more than **450mm from the kerb**,
(v) on a road narrower than **5.5 metres**, or
(vi) on a **traffic island, pedestrian mall, or pedestrian lane**.

**Don't stop** on the roadway **except**:
(i) to **avoid an accident**,
(ii) on a **traffic officer's direction**, or
(iii) for **reasons beyond your control**.

**Don't stop**:
(i) alongside or opposite an **excavation or obstruction** if it would obstruct or endanger traffic,
(ii) in a **tunnel, subway, or on a bridge** (or within 6 metres of one),
(iii) where the roadway has been **narrowed** (or within 6 metres of the narrowing),
(iv) in contravention of a **sign**,
(v) **facing oncoming traffic** on the right side,
(vi) alongside another vehicle on a road **under 9 metres wide**,
(vii) within a **railway level crossing**,
(viii) within **9 metres** of a pedestrian crossing's approach side, or
(ix) anywhere it would **endanger or obstruct traffic**.
Obey **every road traffic sign** and **rule of the road**, unless a traffic officer instructs you otherwise.
**Don't reverse** a vehicle unless it can be done **safely**.

Keep a following distance of **at least 2 seconds** for light motor vehicles and motorcycles, and **at least 3 seconds** for heavy motor vehicles; **increase this** in rain, on a slippery surface, in poor visibility, or when being followed too closely.
**Don't allow** a person, animal, or object to occupy a position that **prevents full control** of the vehicle, or let anyone **interfere with the steering** while driving.
While driving, maintain **complete control** of the vehicle and a **full view** of the road and traffic ahead.
An unattended vehicle must have its **brake set**, or otherwise be **secured**, so it **cannot move** from where it was left.
Before pulling away from a parked or stationary roadside position, make sure it's **safe** and **won't interfere** with approaching traffic.
**Always give an immediate, absolute right of way** to a vehicle sounding a warning device or bell.
**Don't let any part of your body protrude** from a moving vehicle, **except** to give a hand signal.
**Don't allow** a person or animal to occupy the roof, a step, a running board, or any other **external part** of a moving vehicle.

Don't let the engine:
(i) emit **abnormal smoke or fumes**,
(ii) run while the vehicle is **stationary and unattended**, or
(iii) run while **fuel is being delivered** into the tank.
**Don't deposit fuel, oil, grease**, or other flammable or offensive matter on or alongside a road.
**Don't drive, pull, or push** a vehicle on a sidewalk.
A motorcycle rider must obey **every road sign** and **rule of the road**, unless a traffic officer instructs otherwise.
A rider's feet must rest on the **front foot rests**, seated **astride the saddle**, with **at least one hand on the handlebars** at all times.
A passenger must be **briefed by the rider**, seated on a **securely fastened seat**, with feet on **securely fastened foot rests**, astride the motorcycle.
**No more than two people** may ride on a motorcycle, excluding anyone in an attached sidecar.
A passenger may **only** be carried if the motorcycle's engine **exceeds 50cc**, and the passenger must be seated in a **sidecar or astride a pillion**.
**No more than two adults** may be carried in a sidecar attached to a motorcycle.
A rider **may not** carry a person, animal, or bulky object **in front of them**; a non-bulky object may be carried if **securely attached** and doesn't obstruct the rider's view or control.
**Neither** the rider nor passenger may **take hold** of another vehicle that is in motion.
**All wheels** of the motorcycle must stay in **contact with the road surface** at all times.
Riders must travel in **single file** within the same lane, **except briefly to overtake** another motorcycle; two motorcycles **may not overtake** another vehicle at the same time.
A sidecar must be attached to the **left side** of the motorcycle, and **may not be fitted** to a motorcycle with an engine **under 50cc**.
A driver may not hold a **cellular or other communication device** in one or both hands, or with any other part of the body, **while driving**.
A driver must **yield right of way, slow down, or stop** for a pedestrian crossing a roadway within a **pedestrian crossing**.
A driver **may not pass** a vehicle that has stopped at a pedestrian crossing.
A vehicle left in the same place for more than **24 hours** (outside an urban area) or **7 days** (within an urban area) is deemed **abandoned** by its owner.

Don't:
(i) cause a vehicle's wheel to **drag or spin** on the roadway (except in an emergency),
(ii) use **chocks or shoes** between a moving wheel and the road surface, or
(iii) otherwise use or move a vehicle in a way that **damages the road**.

Animal-drawn vehicles, pedal cycles, motorcycles under 50cc or electrically propelled, motor quadrucycles, disability vehicles under 230kg, and tractors (outside road construction or maintenance use) **may not use a freeway**.

**Don't stop** on a freeway except:
(i) by **sign or traffic officer direction**,
(ii) in a designated **stopping/parking area**, or
(iii) for **reasons beyond your control**.

On a freeway:
(i) **don't give a hand signal** (except for reasons beyond your control),
(ii) don't be on it **on foot**, or
(iii) **leave an animal** where it could stray onto one.
If a vehicle ahead wants to merge from an on-ramp, you **must allow it to merge** in front of you.
A motorcycle **may not** be used to **tow** another vehicle.
The tow-rope, chain, or tow-bar between two vehicles **may not exceed 3.5 metres** in length.
Towing at **over 30 km/h** with a rope or chain is **not allowed** -- a **draw-bar or tow-bar** connection is required instead.
